title.rendered: Apple to Donate to Hurricane Melissa Relief Efforts in the Caribbean

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Apple pledges relief aid for Hurricane Melissa victims after the Category 5 storm caused massive destruction and over 50 deaths across the Caribbean.
  • Tim Cook confirmed Apple’s support via X, stating the company will donate to relief efforts, though the donation amount hasn’t been publicly disclosed.
  • Hurricane Melissa’s economic toll could exceed $50 billion, with countries like Jamaica and Haiti facing flooding, power outages, and limited clean water access.
  • Apple’s relief efforts follow its humanitarian track record, including past collaborations with the Red Cross and nearly $900 million raised through Employee Giving.
  • Details on how Apple will assist are still limited, and donations may be funneled through nonprofit partners; direct support pages haven’t yet appeared on Apple.com.

Apple has committed to aiding those affected by Hurricane Melissa, a formidable storm that has left a trail of devastation throughout the Caribbean. This commitment came directly from CEO Tim Cook, who announced it through a post on X, signaling support for the disaster-stricken regions.

Tim Cook Confirms Apple’s Support

Cook’s message emphasized empathy for the impacted areas, stating, “Our hearts go out to all of those impacted by the destruction of Hurricane Melissa. Apple will be making a donation to help with relief efforts on the ground.” While Apple has yet to disclose the exact donation figure, this action places the company among numerous global leaders offering assistance.

Reports from AppleInsider and USA Today indicate that Hurricane Melissa has resulted in at least 50 fatalities and severe destruction in Jamaica, Cuba, Haiti, and the Dominican Republic. The hurricane made its initial impact in Jamaica as a Category 5 storm on October 28, and its unusually slow movement exacerbated flooding and damage across multiple regions.

Billions in Damage Across the Region

Initial assessments pegged the financial toll at approximately $8 billion, but updated figures from AccuWeather suggest a much steeper economic impact, potentially surpassing $50 billion. Many areas continue to grapple with power outages and a lack of clean water, as recovery initiatives unfold across the affected nations.

Apple’s involvement in these relief operations aligns with its longstanding tradition of humanitarian contributions. Historically, the company has collaborated with organizations like the American Red Cross to foster donations and has matched employee contributions through its Employee Giving program. This initiative had raised over $880 million by the close of 2022.

A Continuing Tradition of Corporate Relief

Apple’s support often goes beyond financial donations, extending to contributions of technology and special fundraising campaigns. In past natural disasters, the company has directed users to relief funds prominently featured on its homepage, underlining its overarching commitment to global aid efforts.

With Cook’s latest announcement, Apple continues to affirm its role not just as a tech giant but as a steadfast partner in humanitarian efforts. Although precise details of Apple’s contribution to Hurricane Melissa relief have not been detailed, the company’s engagement is expected to support emergency responses in the Caribbean.

title.rendered: Everything New in iOS 26.1 Update: Just Subtle Fixes

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • iOS 26.1 refines Liquid Glass with better contrast via a new Tinted mode in accessibility settings, improving readability without losing the translucent look.
  • Alarms now require a slide to stop just like the old “slide to unlock,” helping avoid accidental dismissals in the morning.
  • You can now disable swipe-to-open Camera from the Lock Screen in Settings > Camera to prevent pocket launches.
  • Apple Intelligence and AirPods gain more languages, including Portuguese, Vietnamese, Korean, and Italian, expanding AI and translation support globally.
  • Update arrives November 2 at 11 a.m. PT, with improvements to security, multitasking, Photos layout, and manual workout logging in Fitness.

Apple’s iOS 26.1 update is on the horizon, and while it’s a smaller release following iOS 26’s big redesign, it packs a punch by addressing bugs and introducing fresh features. The update mostly focuses on usability tweaks and giving users more control over their devices. This information is according to Cult of Mac and Mashable.

Liquid Glass Gets a Tinted Makeover

The Liquid Glass design from iOS 26, which caught eyes but sometimes made text and buttons a bit tough to see, is being refined in iOS 26.1. Apple now includes a Tinted mode in Settings > Display & Text Size to add subtle contrast without losing that sleek glassy vibe. Users also have the option to go for the Clear style or reduce transparency thanks to accessibility settings if a simpler look is preferred.

In addition, Liquid Glass gets some visual tweaks with:

  • Softer glows when interacting with fields and menus
  • A snappier, livelier animation for the Control Center
  • Keypad buttons in the Phone app getting a fresh reflective gloss
  • Video playback controls in Photos becoming more distinct

Apple seems to be aiming for a design that’s functional yet still holds onto its unique flair.

Slide to Stop: Alarms Get Intentional Again

A sense of nostalgia is hitting iOS 26.1 as Apple reintroduces the slide gesture for turning off alarms. Instead of just tapping a button, users can now swipe to stop their alarms, reminiscent of the old “slide to unlock” feature. This tweak aims to cut down on accidentally dismissing alarms, adding some calm to your mornings.

Disable Accidental Camera Launches from Lock Screen

For those who find their camera app launching in their pockets, iOS 26.1 has a fix in store. Users can now turn off the Lock Screen Swipe to Open Camera feature located in Settings > Camera. It helps prevent those accidental swipes, while still making the camera accessible via the Control Center.

More Languages Join Apple Intelligence and AirPods Translation

In its ongoing push to expand AI capabilities, Apple is rolling out support for eight new languages in Apple Intelligence, with additions like Danish, Dutch, Portuguese, and Vietnamese. Similarly, AirPods Live Translation is gaining languages such as Japanese, Korean, and Italian, broadening accessibility for international users.

iPad Multitasking Returns Stronger Than Before

The iPadOS 26.1 release sees the comeback of the well-loved Slide Over mode, which allows users to open floating app windows that hover over existing apps. It now more closely resembles picture-in-picture functionality — windows can be resized, moved off-screen, and brought back with a simple swipe. Mac-like shortcuts (⌘H, ⌥⌘H, ⌥⌘W) have also been added for quicker multitasking.

Other Subtle Yet Handy Updates

Several other useful tweaks come with iOS 26.1:

  • You can manually log workouts in Fitness with calorie estimates
  • Adjust external microphone levels directly from the Control Center
  • Decide where to save Local Capture recordings, whether audio or video
  • An option to turn off phone call vibrations
  • A new rainbow Apple TV logo reflecting the rebranded “Apple TV” app
  • Left-aligned labels and reorganized menus in Photos for simpler navigation
  • Automatic security updates to keep devices protected

When Will iOS 26.1 Arrive?

As per Cult of Mac, iOS 26.1 is now in the release candidate stage for developers and is set to go live on Monday, November 2, at 11 a.m. Pacific Time. Once it’s available, users can download it via Settings > General > Software Update.

While iOS 26.1 might be tagged as a point update, its refinements to aesthetics, multitasking, and security suggest Apple’s intent on polishing iOS 26 into the smoother and more refined version it aspired to be.

Are you looking forward to this update? Share your thoughts with us below.

excerpt.rendered: iOS 26.1 polishes Apple’s new design with smarter controls, better accessibility, and global AI language support, rolling out November 2.

acceptedAnswer.text: When you want to find something specific in the Messages app, you can perform a search. On the main All Messages screen, swipe down slightly to display the Search box at the top. Pop in your search term and you’ll see results from every conversation related to that term, including text, photos, links, or other items.

mainEntity.name: Do iMessage photos get saved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even with the Automatic Sharing feature enabled, as explained here, photos and videos you receive in Messages are not saved by default. If you delete the conversation, the photos will be deleted too. You can check out our how-to for saving photos from Messages to your iPhone or iPad to hold onto those important pictures.

mainEntity.name: Can I delete certain words from the iPhone keyboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can reset your keyboard to remove words from iPhone Predictive text, the iPhone doesn't have a built-in method for deleting certain words from the keyboard. That said, some third-party keyboards allow you to do so.

mainEntity.name: How to change the keyboard on your iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching the keyboard on the iPhone is easy. Open Settings → tap General → Keyboard → Keyboards → tap Add New Keyboard → Edit → drag the preferred keyboard using the three lines. For more details, take a look at this comprehensive guide to changing the keyboard on iPhone.

mainEntity.name: Why does my iPhone say "Cannot Connect to App Store" even with good internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: This may happen due to incorrect date and time settings, issues with your Apple ID, or App Store server problems. Verify these settings first.

mainEntity.name: Will I lose my data if I reset the network or all settings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resetting network settings only erases Wi-Fi and Bluetooth settings. Resetting all settings doesn't erase personal data, but does revert all system settings.

mainEntity.name: Why does the App Store need my location?

acceptedAnswer.text: The App Store may use your location to provide region-specific content or comply with local regulations.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, iCloud stores your Safari tabs if iCloud Sync is enabled for Safari, but they are not included in iCloud backups. acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only if you allowed Safari to use iCloud in the first place. If you have, then all your Safari Bookmarks, Reading List, Tab Groups, and open browser tabs are automatically backed up.

title.rendered: iOS 26.1 Brings Back Classic 2007 Feature in a Modern Way

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • iOS 26.1 revives a modern take on the classic 2007 “slide” gesture.
  • The Clock app introduces a new “slide to stop” feature to replace the tap-based alarm control.
  • This change prevents accidental alarm dismissals while adding a nostalgic touch for longtime iPhone users.
  • The Release Candidate suggests a public rollout early next week.
  • Other updates include visual refinements, performance enhancements, and general bug fixes.

Apple is set to release iOS 26.1, an update nodding back to one of the iPhone’s earliest innovations: the “slide” functionality. According to MacRumors, the new update revamps the Clock app’s alarm feature by replacing the “Stop” button with a fresh “slide to stop” method.

Slide to Stop: A Nostalgic but Practical Change

In the current iOS 26, tapping a simple “Stop” button to silence alarms has led to accidental shut-offs, often resulting in oversleeping. With iOS 26.1, users will need to slide to silence the alarm, reminiscent of the old “slide to unlock” feature pioneered in 2007’s iPhone models.

This tweak is seemingly minor but addresses a common user complaint while adding a touch of nostalgia for those familiar with the original iPhone’s lock mechanics. Apple’s update underscores its commitment to refining usability, ensuring features work better in users’ daily lives. It offers a retro-style solution for those who want to prevent inadvertently silencing their alarms.

iOS 26.1 Release Timeline

MacRumors reports that Apple has released the iOS 26.1 Release Candidate to developers and beta testers earlier this week. This usually indicates that a public release is imminent, likely slated for early next week, possibly on Monday or Tuesday, for supported iPhones.

A Quick Recap of iOS 26.1 Changes

Aside from this callback to the past, iOS 26.1 introduces various subtle tweaks and visual upgrades across the system. Users can now tweak the appearance of the Liquid Glass design, alongside enjoying general performance improvements and bug fixes.

However, the “slide to stop” stands out not just as a functional change but for its design nostalgia, subtly tying modern iPhones to their 2007 origins.

Would a feature like this improve your iPhone experience? We’d love to hear your thoughts.

mainEntity.name: How to search in iMessage?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you want to find something specific in the Messages app, you can perform a search. On the main All Messages screen, swipe down slightly to display the Search box at the top. Pop in your search term and you’ll see results from every conversation related to that term, including text, photos, links, or other items.

mainEntity.name: Do iMessage photos get saved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even with the Automatic Sharing feature enabled, as explained here, photos and videos you receive in Messages are not saved by default. If you delete the conversation, the photos will be deleted too. You can check out our how-to for saving photos from Messages to your iPhone or iPad to hold onto those important pictures.

mainEntity.name: Do iMessage photos get saved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even with the Automatic Sharing feature enabled, as explained here, photos and videos you receive in Messages are not saved by default. If you delete the conversation, the photos will be deleted too. You can check out our how-to for saving photos from Messages to your iPhone or iPad to hold onto those important pictures.

mainEntity.name: Can I delete certain words from the iPhone keyboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can reset your keyboard to remove words from iPhone Predictive text, the iPhone doesn't have a built-in method for deleting certain words from the keyboard. That said, some third-party keyboards allow you to do so.

mainEntity.name: How to change the keyboard on your iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching the keyboard on the iPhone is easy. Open Settings → tap General → Keyboard → Keyboards → tap Add New Keyboard → Edit → drag the preferred keyboard using the three lines. For more details, take a look at this comprehensive guide to changing the keyboard on iPhone.

mainEntity.name: Why does my iPhone say "Cannot Connect to App Store" even with good internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: This may happen due to incorrect date and time settings, issues with your Apple ID, or App Store server problems. Verify these settings first.

mainEntity.name: Will I lose my data if I reset the network or all settings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resetting network settings only erases Wi-Fi and Bluetooth settings. Resetting all settings doesn't erase personal data, but does revert all system settings.

mainEntity.name: Why does the App Store need my location?

acceptedAnswer.text: The App Store may use your location to provide region-specific content or comply with local regulations.

mainEntity.name: What if I can't change date/time or location settings?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your device is managed by your employer, school, or parental controls, some settings may be restricted. Check for device management profiles under Settings → General → VPN & Device Management.

mainEntity.name: Does iCloud back up Safari tabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, iCloud stores your Safari tabs if iCloud Sync is enabled for Safari, but they are not included in iCloud backups. When iCloud sync is enabled, your tabs are available on all Apple devices signed in with your Apple ID. To preserve Safari tabs, you should use an encrypted computer backup.

mainEntity.name: Does Safari back up iPhone tabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but only if you allowed Safari to use iCloud in the first place. If you have, then all your Safari Bookmarks, Reading List, Tab Groups, and open browser tabs are automatically backed up.

mainEntity.name: How long does Safari History stay on iPhone or iPad?

title.rendered: Apple Q4 2025 Earnings Breakdown: iPhone and Services Drive Record Revenue

content.rendered:
Apple concluded its fiscal Q4 2025 with a bang, posting unprecedented figures. The company’s latest earnings report reveals an impressive $102.5 billion in revenue, reflecting an 8% increase from last year, as several product lines achieved new milestones.

iPhone Revenue Hits $49 Billion on Strong 17-Series Demand

Once again, iPhone sales dominated Apple’s earnings, generating $49.02 billion and marking a 6% rise from the previous year. CEO Tim Cook attributed this success to the iPhone 17 series, highlighting the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max, which debuted earlier than usual in September. The blend of high-end options and quicker upgrade cycles attracted significant consumer interest leading up to the holidays.

Cook also pointed to the iPhone Air, a fresh addition that offers premium Pro features at a lower cost, which found favor in overseas markets. Despite encountering supply issues for specific models, the iPhone segment achieved record-setting results for the quarter.

Services Revenue Sets All-Time Record at $28.8 Billion

Apple’s Services arm, including revenue from iCloud, Apple Music, and the App Store, reached an unprecedented $28.75 billion, a 15% year-on-year growth. This increase is credited to a rising base of active devices and a boost in paid subscriptions.

Now Apple’s second-largest business area, Services significantly contributes to maintaining high profit margins and steady revenue, especially amidst hardware sales’ ups and downs. Its consistent income flow lifted Apple’s gross margin to a record 47.2% for the September quarter.

Wearables, Home, and Accessories See Stable Growth

The Wearables, Home, and Accessories division reported $9.01 billion in revenue, nearly mirroring the prior year’s results. Apple noted that launches like AirPods Pro 3 and the new Apple Watch series kept this category firm despite market saturation. The timing of these product releases accompanying iPhone introductions helped boost consumer interest and sales as the holiday season approached.

Mac Revenue Rises 13% With New M5 Systems

Apple’s Mac segment saw a boost, earning $8.73 billion, a 13% rise compared to the previous year. This growth is fueled by the new MacBook Pro models featuring the M5 chip, rolled out just ahead of the back-to-school rush. The improved performance and battery life of M5 systems have enticed professional users, helping Apple regain traction in this segment.

iPad Revenue Holds Steady With Pro Models

iPad revenue remained steady at $6.95 billion this quarter, showing little change from last year. Apple highlighted that the updated iPad Pro with M5 played a crucial role in sustaining demand, especially among creative professionals and enterprise clients. The iPad segment remains stable, even as Apple gears up for more extensive updates to the lineup.

Record Year and Strong Outlook Ahead

With fiscal 2025 coming to a close, Apple has reported $416.2 billion in total revenue and $112 billion in net income, both all-time highs for the company. Operating cash flow was listed at $29.7 billion, with $24 billion returned to shareholders via buybacks and dividends.

Although faced with challenges such as increased R&D expenditures and economic slowdowns in China, Apple reported record sales in emerging markets like India, where it saw new performance peaks.

As the holiday quarter kicks off, Apple claims to have its most comprehensive product lineup yet, covering the iPhone 17 series as well as the latest in Mac, iPad, and accessory offerings. While no formal guidance for December was provided, the focus remains on ensuring product availability and maintaining customer satisfaction.

Are these developments significant for you? Share your thoughts below.

mainEntity.name: Can I delete certain words from the iPhone keyboard?

title.rendered: Leaker Suggests New Colors for iPhone 18 Pro: Coffee, Purple, Burgundy

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • New color leak: iPhone 18 Pro could debut in Coffee, Purple, and Burgundy.
  • Design direction: Apple appears to be leaning toward warmer, more fashion-focused tones.
  • Unique additions: Coffee and Burgundy are new, while Purple returns from earlier models.
  • Source insight: Leaks originate from Weibo accounts Instant Digital and Digital Chat Station.
  • Hardware expectations: Possible A20 chip, variable aperture camera, and C2 modem upgrades.
  • Launch timeline: The iPhone 18 Pro is expected to be unveiled in September 2026.

Apple seems to be lining up a fresh palette for the iPhone 18 Pro, set to arrive next year. A leak from the well-known Weibo account, Instant Digital, hints that the upcoming models might don shades like Coffee, Purple, and Burgundy. This would fit Apple’s recent approach, leaning towards bolder, more elegant finishes.

The iPhone 17 Pro, which launched just last month, came in colors like Silver, Deep Blue, and Cosmic Orange. This represented a departure from Apple’s more traditional shades of black and gray. Even with some user surprise at the lack of darker hues, Apple may not be reverting with the iPhone 18 Pro lineup.

Coffee and Burgundy Could Replace Classic Shades

Assuming the leaks hold up, these would be new additions to the iPhone’s color range. While Purple has made appearances in previous models such as the iPhone XR, iPhone 11, iPhone 12, and iPhone 14 Pro, Coffee and Burgundy would be unique introductions. The Coffee tone, likened to espresso or leather, might serve as a contemporary nod to previous models like the gold iPhone XS or the Desert Titanium iPhone 16 Pro. Burgundy blends deep red with touches of purple and brown, aiming for a sophisticated, wine-like hue.

These color choices indicate Apple may be trying to give its Pro series a more fashion-conscious appeal, building on the bright Cosmic Orange seen this year.

Leak Origin and Translation Variations

The original hint came from Instant Digital, with Digital Chat Station also throwing its weight behind the claims. Translations of the leak vary slightly, some noting the colors as Coffee, Purple, and Wine Red, or others as Coffee Brown, Purple, and Burgundy. However, they all steer towards a similar warm color spectrum.

As with all speculative reports, these details might shift as Apple progresses through the iPhone 18 Pro’s development stages. Still, it’s notable as the first significant color rumor for the lineup expected to roll out in September 2026.

What Else to Expect from iPhone 18 Pro

Apart from the potential new colors, the iPhone 18 Pro is tipped to introduce several notable hardware upgrades. Word on the street suggests Apple could integrate its new A20 chip, utilizing TSMC’s 2nm process, alongside a variable aperture main camera and an updated C2 modem to boost connectivity. Also anticipated is a revamped Camera Control system to enhance user experience.

With these speculative features, the iPhone 18 Pro could pair cutting-edge hardware with some of the most daring color choices Apple has ever released.

Would these potential color changes matter to your decision? Share your thoughts below.

title.rendered: How to See Watch History on Instagram

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways:

  • Instagram lacks a true watch history feature: The app doesn’t store or show a list of all the videos you’ve viewed, unlike YouTube’s “Recently Watched” tab.
  • Instagram only tracks engagement-based activity: Videos and Reels appear in your history only if you’ve liked, commented, saved, or shared them — not just viewed them.
  • Watch History vs. Activity Log explained: A watch history would show every viewed video, while the Activity Log only records posts you’ve interacted with directly.
  • Manual ways to find watched content: Revisit your liked Reels, check saved collections, explore recent search suggestions, or browse your Stories archive to retrace viewed content.
  • Avoid third-party “watch history” apps: These apps often misuse data, violate Instagram’s policies, or pose privacy risks — use only Instagram’s native tools for safety.

Have you ever found yourself desperately scrolling to rediscover a Reel you watched earlier on Instagram, but it just vanished? You’re not alone. The good news is that Instagram has finally introduced a dedicated Reels watch history feature, putting an end to all that endless scrolling.

You can now easily revisit the Reels you’ve watched recently or even a month back, right within the app. This long-awaited addition makes it simpler to find, rewatch, and share your favorite videos, no more relying on likes or saves as workarounds.

Let’s walk you through how this watch history feature works and where to find it.

Table of Contents
  • What Instagram Tracks: Reels, Videos, and Live Streams
    • 1. Reels and In-Feed Videos
    • 2. Live Streams
  • Instagram Watch History vs. Activity Log
  • How to Check Your Reels Watch History on Instagram
  • How to Revisit Liked Reels and Posts on Instagram
  • Stay on Top of Your Watch Habits

What Instagram Tracks: Reels, Videos, and Live Streams

Except for Reels, Instagram tracks only the content you engage with, not what you simply watch. Here’s a breakdown:

1. Reels and In-Feed Videos

  • Every Reel you watch is tracked and can be found in your watch history.
  • In-feed videos that aren’t labeled as Reels are only tracked if you like, comment, save, or share, and can be found later in your Liked Posts or Saved Collections.

2. Live Streams

  • Not tracked unless you interact or the creator saves it to their profile.
  • You can’t revisit a live video unless the creator uploads it afterward.

Instagram Watch History vs. Activity Log

Many users confuse Watch History with the Activity Log. Here’s the difference:

  • Watch History is a part of the Activity Log and lists all the Reels you’ve watched.
  • Activity Log only shows the content you’ve liked, saved, shared, or commented on.

So, while you can easily revisit any watched Reels, you’ll still need to engage with other content types if you want them to appear in your activity records later.

How to Check Your Reels Watch History on Instagram

Instagram’s Reels watch history feature is hidden under the Your Activity section in plain sight. Here’s how you can access it:

  1. Open the Instagram app and head to your profile.
  2. Tap the hamburger icon (More Options) in the top-right corner.
  3. Next, locate and tap ‘Your activity‘ under ‘How you use Instagram‘.
  4. Now, scroll down to the bottom and tap Watch History.
  5. You’ll see a chronological list of Reels you’ve watched. Tap an item to revisit.
  6. You can also sort the list from oldest to newest, and filter it by date and author.

How to Revisit Liked Reels and Posts on Instagram

If, for some reason, the Watch History feature isn’t available to you yet, or you want to revisit content other than Reels, you can use the Activity Log to revisit the content you liked or commented on. Here’s how:

  1. Open your Instagram profile, then tap the hamburger icon in the top-right corner.
  2. Locate and tap Your Activity.
  3. Here, tap Likes or Comments under ‘Interactions‘.
    • View the content you liked or commented on in the past.

Stay on Top of Your Watch Habits

Since the arrival of Reels on Instagram, one of the most frustrating things has been losing a great Reel you watched and not being able to find it again. But thanks to Instagram now offering a dedicated Watch History for Reels, that problem is finally addressed. Additionally, you still need to rely on interacting with content other than Reels if you want to revisit it later.

The Reels Watch History feature is finally here for everyone! Have you tried it yet? Tell us in the comments which Reel you revisited first.

  • Can You See Who Unfollowed You on Instagram?
  • How to Download Instagram Reels on iPhone
  • How to Remix Reels on Instagram and Go Viral
  • Why You See Sensitive Content on Instagram and How to Control It

keyPoints.title: Instagram Doesn't Have a Watch History Feature
keyPoints.explanation: Unlike YouTube, Instagram doesn't provide a log of viewed videos or a 'Recently Watched' tab; content not interacted with isn't stored or accessible.

keyPoints.title: What Instagram Tracks: Engagements Only
keyPoints.explanation: Instagram tracks Reels and videos only if you like, comment, save, or share, and this can later be found in your liked posts or saved collections.

keyPoints.title: Difference Between Watch History and Activity Log
keyPoints.explanation: Watch History would show all videos you’ve viewed, while the Activity Log only displays content you've liked, saved, or commented on.

keyPoints.title: Workarounds to Check Viewed Content
keyPoints.explanation: You can revisit liked Reels, use search suggestions, check your saved collections, or access your Stories archive to manually track your watched content.

keyPoints.title: Avoid Third-Party Apps for Viewing History
keyPoints.explanation: Third-party apps claiming to show your Instagram watch history are often inaccurate, pose security risks, or violate Instagram policies; stick to native features for safety.

title.rendered: Best Sleeves for the 14-inch MacBook Pro in 2026

content.rendered:
If you’ve just picked up Apple’s 14-inch MacBook Pro M5, you already know how premium and powerful it is. But that sleek aluminum design deserves proper protection when you’re on the go. A sleeve is one of the simplest accessories you can buy. It shields your MacBook from scratches, dust, and bumps without adding bulk.  

In this guide, we’ll look at what makes a good laptop sleeve, then explore the top 7 options for the 14-inch MacBook Pro. I’ve included sleeves with minimalist style, premium materials, and extra functionality so you’ll find one that fits your needs. 

Table of Contents
  • Key Factors to Consider Before Buying
  • 7 Best 14-inch MacBook Pro Sleeves
    • 1. tomtoc 360 Protective Laptop Sleeve
    • 2. Orbitkey Hybrid Laptop Sleeve
    • 3. MOFT 2-in-1 MacBook Sleeve & Stand
    • 4. Lacdo Laptop Sleeve Bag
    • 5. JETech Slim Leather Sleeve
    • 6. MOSISO Laptop Sleeve Bag with Small Case
    • 7. Casemade Real Leather MacBook Sleeve
  • Final Verdict: Which MacBook Pro Sleeve Should You Buy?

Key Factors to Consider Before Buying 

Before adding anything to your cart, here are a few points to keep in mind: 

  • Size and Fit: Your sleeve should fit the 14-inch MacBook Pro snugly. Too tight and you risk scratching the surface while removing it. Loose fit makes your MacBook slide around inside. Always check compatibility before buying. 
  • Material and Protection: Common materials include neoprene, felt, polyester, leather, or hybrid composites. Harder materials generally have better impact resistance, while softer ones are more comfortable to carry and store.
  • Interior Padding: That should be soft enough inside to avoid scratching the finish on your MacBook. Some sleeves incorporate additional foam padding or corner bumpers for drop protection.
  • Water Resistance: If you frequently commute or travel, a water-resistant outer layer can save your MacBook from accidental spills or rain. 
  • Extra Storage: Do you carry a charger, cables, or an external SSD? Some sleeves include extra compartments or accessory pockets for that. 
  • Design and Portability: Sleek, professional designs look great for work, while colorful or textured sleeves might appeal to creatives. Consider whether you want handles, a strap, or a simple slip-in style. 
  • Budget: Expect $15–$30 for basics, up to $80+ for fancy features like stands or mouse pads.

7 Best 14-inch MacBook Pro Sleeves

Here I are some of the best MacBook sleeves, selected for their usability and unique features.

1. tomtoc 360 Protective Laptop Sleeve

tomtoc sleeves come in a couple of colors and designs, but each one nails everyday usability for the 14-inch MacBook Pro M5. The classic version uses recycled fabrics with CornerArmor tech, high-resilience edges, and high-density inner padding. Thus, the sleeve provides military-grade drop protection without bulk.

Moreover, it’s water-resistant, has a soft lining to avoid scratches, and includes a front pocket for accessories and an additional strap for your AirTag or key. tomtoc’s new Protective Puffy Laptop Sleeve amps up the lightweight feel with a quilted design like a plush cushion.

It’s great for users who travel or commute daily, thanks to the unbeatable protection-to-price ratio and eco-friendly material. However, the front pocket is small for big chargers. 

Best for: Users who want maximum protection without extra weight. 

2. Orbitkey Hybrid Laptop Sleeve

Orbitkey products are known for quality and innovation, and its Hybrid Laptop Sleeve is no exception. It doubles as a carry case and workstation. Made from vegan leather and recycled woven fabric, it houses your 14-inch MBP safe with a silent magnetic closure.

Flip its tri-fold open, and the interior doubles as a mouse pad/desk mat, perfect for impromptu workspace setups. It’s not the most padded sleeve on this list, but the combination of style, utility, and sustainability makes it a premium choice for people who work on the go. 

However, there’s no dedicated pocket for extras, and it’s a bit pricier for basics. 

Best for: Remote workers or students who want a sleeve that doubles as a portable desk mat. 

3. MOFT 2-in-1 MacBook Sleeve & Stand

MOFT’s 2-in-1 Laptop Carry Sleeve is all about slim, smart design. Its heavy-duty PU material safes your MacBook from scratches and daily wear. Though the sleeve is only 0.28″ thin, you get an expandable back pocket for chargers, and it slips into any bag without fuss.

The best part? The sleeve folds into an invisible stand with 15- or 25-degree angles, easing neck strain during long sessions. So, it’s a smart buy for remote pros who work on laptops or tablets. But it’s not drop-proof, and the PU vegan material might wear faster. 

Best for: Minimalists and remote professionals who value flexibility and aesthetics. 

4. Lacdo Laptop Sleeve Bag

Lacdo’s Protective Briefcase keeps it practical with anti-scratch canvas fabric, a water-repellent coating, shockproof fleece lining, and three pockets (two zippered front pockets, one back flap) for all your gear. The top metal zipper opens wide for easy grabs, and thickened edges cushion daily jostles. 

While carrying your MacBook, you can use the grab-handle on top. It’s stretchable, so you can switch between a laptop briefcase, handbag, and laptop sleeve bag. Overall, it’s a no-brainer for budget users and commuters who want to stuff it with extras, though it can feel baggy on the slim MacBook Pro.

Best for: Budget-conscious users who want solid all-around protection. 

5. JETech Slim Leather Sleeve

JETech delivers straightforward shielding with waterproof PU leather and soft lining. It has a modern, minimalist look with a magnetic flap closure that’s both elegant and functional. The envelope-style insert makes sliding in quick. 

Additionally, the sleeve is ultra-slim, making it perfect for slipping into a backpack or tote. That said, there’s no extra pocket, so it’s ideal for those who travel light. Also, the minimal padding is not for rough use. 

Best for: Users who prefer a simple, slim sleeve for light commuting. 

6. MOSISO Laptop Sleeve Bag with Small Case

MOSISO’s neoprene sleeve comes with a matching mini-pouch for mouse or cables, in a rainbow of colors to match your vibe. Its triple-layered design with elastic neoprene, shockproof sponge, and fluffy fleece lining absorbs bumps well and fits the MBP snugly. 

Moreover, the soft Lycra exterior is water-resistant. The sleeve comes in a variety of colors, making it a fun option for students or casual users. It’s budget-friendly, lightweight, soft, and flexible, but not the best for heavy protection.

Best for: Students or casual users who want a colorful, affordable sleeve. 

7. Casemade Real Leather MacBook Sleeve

Casemade goes luxe with full-grain cowhide leather and wool felt lining that cradles your MacBook Pro softly, preventing slips. It’s hand-stitched for durability, aging into a patina that looks pro without trying.

With a slim, lightweight design, it fits bags seamlessly. While it doesn’t offer heavy-duty protection, it stands out for its professional, premium aesthetic, perfect for meetings or executive settings. 

Best for: Professionals who value elegance and craftsmanship over bulk. 

Final Verdict: Which MacBook Pro Sleeve Should You Buy? 

Your pick boils down to priorities. If you want the best all-around protection on a dime, the tomtoc sleeve is hard to beat. It’s rugged, well-built, and travel-ready. 

For those who work remotely or frequently move between spaces, the Orbitkey Hybrid and MOFT sleeve are smart, versatile choices. They offer a professional style with functional benefits, such as a mouse pad or an integrated stand. 

On the other hand, Lacdo is your storage champ with a briefcase design. And for anyone who just wants something simple and affordable, MOSISO or JETech gets the job done without breaking the bank. 

Ultimately, the best sleeve depends on how and where you use your laptop. Pick one that fits your lifestyle, and your 14-inch MacBook Pro will stay safe and stylish wherever you take it. 

So, which sleeve did you add to your cart? Let me know in the comments below!

@graph.name: tomtoc 360 Protective Laptop Sleeve
@graph.description: tomtoc sleeves come in a couple of colors and designs, but each one nails everyday usability for the 14-inch MacBook Pro M5. The classic version uses recycled fabrics with CornerArmor tech, high-resilience edges, and high-density inner padding. Thus, the sleeve provides military-grade drop protection without bulk.

@graph.name: Orbitkey Hybrid Laptop Sleeve
@graph.description: Orbitkey products are known for quality and innovation, and its Hybrid Laptop Sleeve is no exception. It doubles as a carry case and workstation. Made from vegan leather and recycled woven fabric, it houses your 14-inch MBP safe with a silent magnetic closure.

@graph.name: MOFT 2-in-1 MacBook Sleeve & Stand
@graph.description: MOFT’s 2-in-1 Laptop Carry Sleeve is all about slim, smart design. Its heavy-duty PU material safes your MacBook from scratches and daily wear. Though the sleeve is only 0.28″ thin, you get an expandable back pocket for chargers, and it slips into any bag without fuss.

@graph.name: Lacdo Laptop Sleeve Bag
@graph.description: Lacdo’s Protective Briefcase keeps it practical with anti-scratch canvas fabric, a water-repellent coating, shockproof fleece lining, and three pockets (two zippered front pockets, one back flap) for all your gear. The top metal zipper opens wide for easy grabs, and thickened edges cushion daily jostles.

@graph.name: JETech Slim Leather Sleeve
@graph.description: JETech delivers straightforward shielding with waterproof PU leather and soft lining. It has a modern, minimalist look with a magnetic flap closure that’s both elegant and functional. The envelope-style insert makes sliding in quick.

@graph.name: MOSISO Laptop Sleeve Bag with Small Case
@graph.description: MOSISO’s neoprene sleeve comes with a matching mini-pouch for mouse or cables, in a rainbow of colors to match your vibe. Its triple-layered design with elastic neoprene, shockproof sponge, and fluffy fleece lining absorbs bumps well and fits the MBP snugly.

@graph.name: Casemade Real Leather MacBook Sleeve
@graph.description: Casemade goes luxe with full-grain cowhide leather and wool felt lining that cradles your MacBook Pro softly, preventing slips. It’s hand-stitched for durability, aging into a patina that looks pro without trying.

title.rendered: How to Factory Reset Apple Watch: Step-by-Step Guide

content.rendered:
Your Apple Watch can usually handle anything you throw at it, but even the best tech sometimes needs a quick restart or a full reset. Whether it’s frozen, unresponsive, or you’ve forgotten the passcode, learning how to factory reset your Apple Watch the right way can save you time and frustration.

Table of Contents
  • How to Restart Apple Watch (Soft Reset)
    • Watch this tutorial to learn how to restart or force restart your Apple Watch.
  • How to Factory Reset Apple Watch (Hard Reset)
    • Method 1: Unpair Apple Watch To Reset Automatically
    • Method 2: Reset Directly from the Watch
    • Method 3: Reset Apple Watch Using iPhone
    • Method 4: Alternate Button Combination Reset (Last Resort)
  • Important Safety Tips for Apple Watch Reset
  • What to Do After Resetting Apple Watch
  • Restart and reboot your Apple Watch to get a fresh start!

How to Restart Apple Watch (Soft Reset)

Restarting your Apple Watch fixes small glitches without deleting data. It’s like rebooting your iPhone, quick and harmless.

Before restarting, make sure your watch isn’t on charge.

  1. Press and hold the Side Button until the Power Off slider appears.
  2. Drag the Power Off slider to shut down your watch.
  3. Wait a few seconds, then press and hold the Side Button again until you see the Apple logo.

If your Apple Watch is frozen and unresponsive, try a force restart: press and hold both the Side Button and Digital Crown for at least 10 seconds until the Apple logo appears.

This doesn’t erase your data; it just refreshes your system and clears temporary issues.

Watch this tutorial to learn how to restart or force restart your Apple Watch.

How to Factory Reset Apple Watch (Hard Reset)

A hard reset, or factory reset, wipes your Apple Watch clean. Use this when you forget your passcode, plan to sell or give it away, or when nothing else works.

Method 1: Unpair Apple Watch To Reset Automatically

If you can access your iPhone, unpairing your watch is always the best way to reset it. It removes Activation Lock and automatically creates a backup.

  1. Keep your iPhone and Apple Watch close.
  2. Open the Watch app > All Watches > tap the info (i) icon next to your watch.
  3. Tap Unpair Apple Watch.
  4. Enter your Apple ID password to disable Activation Lock.
  5. For GPS + Cellular models, choose whether to keep or remove your mobile plan.

After unpairing, your watch shows the Start Pairing screen and your iPhone stores the backup. For more details, check out our guide on unpairing an Apple Watch.

Method 2: Reset Directly from the Watch

You can reset your Apple Watch even without your iPhone, but it must stay connected to the charger during the process.

  1. Open the Settings app on Apple Watch and go to General.
  2. Select the Reset option, then tap Erase all content and Settings.
  3. Enter your passcode.
  4. Wait for the reset to finish, then set up your watch again.
Note This erases all data but doesn’t remove Activation Lock. You’ll need the Apple ID and password used with the watch to set it up again.

Method 3: Reset Apple Watch Using iPhone

If your iPhone is still paired, this is the easiest and safest way to reset your watch; it also automatically removes Activation Lock.

  1. Keep your Apple Watch and iPhone close together.
  2. Open the Watch app on your iPhone.
  3. Go to My Watch > General > Reset.
  4. Tap Erase Apple Watch Content and Settings.
  5. Confirm and enter your Apple ID password if asked.

If you have a GPS + Cellular model, you’ll see an option to either keep or remove your mobile plan. Keep it if you’ll pair with the same iPhone again, or remove it if you’re selling or switching devices.

Your iPhone automatically backs up your Apple Watch before resetting it, so you can restore everything later.

Method 4: Alternate Button Combination Reset (Last Resort)

If your Apple Watch doesn’t respond to any standard reset method, try this. This may not work on recent models, but for any old models like the Apple Watch Series 2, this should work even now:

  1. Press and hold both the Side Button and Digital Crown for about 10 seconds until the Apple logo appears.
  2. Wait a few seconds, then hold only the Side Button for around 20 seconds until the reset option appears.
  3. Tap Erase All Settings, then confirm with the green check button.

Important Safety Tips for Apple Watch Reset

  • Never insert anything into the small holes on your Apple Watch; they’re not reset buttons. They’re for the microphone, speakers, and water-depth sensors.
  • Unpair from iPhone first if you’re selling or giving your watch away. This ensures Activation Lock is removed.
  • Use the charger while resetting to prevent interruptions or damage.

What to Do After Resetting Apple Watch

Once your Apple Watch restarts or resets, it’s time to set it up again.

  • Set up as new for a fresh start.
  • Restore from backup to get all your old data back.

After setup, reconnect to Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, pair it with your iPhone, re-add Apple Pay cards, reinstall apps, and re-enable Health and Activity tracking.

If your Apple Watch still doesn’t respond or won’t reset even after trying everything, contact Apple Support for help.

Restarting or resetting your Apple Watch can often solve most issues, from a stuck screen to a forgotten passcode. It’s a simple fix that can save hours of frustration and make your watch feel brand new again.

Restart and reboot your Apple Watch to get a fresh start!

In short, restarting or resetting your Apple Watch isn’t something to fear; it’s often the quickest way to bring it back to life. A simple restart clears small bugs, while a full reset gives your watch a clean slate when nothing else works. Just remember to unpair it first if you’re switching devices or selling it. Once you’ve set it up again, your Apple Watch will feel as smooth and responsive as the day you bought it.

@graph.name: How to Reset your Apple Watch using your iPhone
@graph.description: Easily reset your Apple Watch using your iPhone by unpairing it through the Watch app. This method also helps erase all content and settings from your Watch.

step.name: Open Watch app and access All Watches
step.text: Launch the Watch app on your iPhone and tap 'All Watches' in the top-left corner of the screen.

itemListElement.text: Open the Watch app on your iPhone.
Tap 'All Watches' in the top-left corner.

step.name: Unpair your Apple Watch
step.text: Tap the info (i) icon next to your Apple Watch, then tap 'Unpair Apple Watch' and confirm the action.

itemListElement.text: Tap the 'i' button next to your Apple Watch under the My Watches section.
Tap 'Unpair Apple Watch' at the bottom.
If you have a cellular plan, choose to keep or remove it depending on whether you’ll pair the watch again.
Enter your Apple ID password and tap 'Unpair' in the top-right corner.

@graph.name: How to Reset your Apple Watch without your iPhone
@graph.description: Learn how to factory reset your Apple Watch directly from the device without using your iPhone. This is helpful if you've lost access to your iPhone or are preparing your watch for a new user.

step.name: Open Settings and navigate to Reset
step.text: On your Apple Watch, open the Settings app, scroll down to General, and tap on it. Then scroll down and select Reset.

itemListElement.text: Open the Settings app on your Apple Watch.
Scroll down and tap on General.
Scroll to the bottom and select Reset.

step.name: Erase all content and settings
step.text: Tap on Erase All Content and Settings. Enter your passcode when prompted. If you have a cellular model, choose whether to keep or remove your data plan.

itemListElement.text: Tap Erase All Content and Settings.
Enter your Apple Watch passcode.
If prompted, choose whether to keep or remove your data plan.

@graph.name: How to Reset Your Apple Watch without a Passcode
@graph.description: Easily reset your Apple Watch without needing the passcode by following these simple steps. Perfect if you're locked out or giving away the device.

step.name: Connect Apple Watch to charger
step.text: Place your Apple Watch on its charger to begin the reset process.

itemListElement.text: Connect your Apple Watch to its magnetic charger.

step.name: Press and hold the Side button
step.text: Hold the Side button until the power icon shows up in the top right corner.

itemListElement.text: Press and hold the Side button on the watch.

step.name: Hold the Digital Crown
step.text: Keep holding the Digital Crown until you see the option to erase all content and settings.

itemListElement.text: Press and hold the Digital Crown until the erase option appears.

step.name: Tap Reset
step.text: Once the option shows up, tap on Reset to begin the process.

itemListElement.text: Tap the Reset button when it appears on the screen.

step.name: Confirm the reset
step.text: You'll be asked to confirm the reset, so tap Reset again to finalize.

itemListElement.text: Tap Reset again to confirm the action.

keyPoints.title: How to Factory Reset Your Apple Watch with an iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: You can easily reset your Apple Watch using the Watch app on your paired iPhone, which also removes Activation Lock and unpairs the device.

keyPoints.title: Factory Resetting Your Apple Watch Without an iPhone
keyPoints.explanation: If your iPhone isn't nearby, you can reset your Apple Watch directly from the device by using the Settings app and erasing all content and settings.

keyPoints.title: Resetting Apple Watch Without a Passcode
keyPoints.explanation: To reset an Apple Watch without a passcode, connect it to a charger, force a reset through the side button and Digital Crown, then confirm the reset.

keyPoints.title: Removing Activation Lock After Reset
keyPoints.explanation: Factory resetting via the iPhone removes Activation Lock automatically, but resetting directly on the watch requires removing it from your Apple ID account separately.

keyPoints.title: Important Note on Activation Lock Removal
keyPoints.explanation: To fully remove Activation Lock, the previous owner must remove the Apple Watch from their Apple ID via the Find My app, as a reset alone doesn't disable the lock.

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. title.rendered: How to use Apple’s Self Service Repair Program to fix your iPhone, iPad, or Mac

content.rendered:
Key Takeaways
  • Apple’s Self Service Repair Program lets you fix your own iPhone, iPad, or Mac using official Apple parts and tools.
  • The program supports a range of iPhones, iPads, and Macs and provides detailed manuals to guide you through the process.
  • While self-repair can be rewarding and sometimes more affordable, it’s also time-consuming and risky if you’re not careful.

Let’s face it: repairing an Apple device can cost a fortune and involve days of waiting. But not anymore—thanks to Apple’s Self Service Repair Program, you can fix your iPhone, iPad, or Mac on your own with genuine Apple parts and tools. Sounds good? This guide walks you through how to start with Apple’s self-repair service, where to order the toolkit, how much it costs, and whether it’s right for you.

What is Apple’s Self Service Repair Program?

Apple launched the Self Service Repair Program for iPhone and Mac in April 2022. It allows you to repair supported models using the same tools and genuine Apple parts used by technicians at the Genius Bar. In 2025, Apple has expanded its Self Service Repair program to include a range of iPad models.

You get access to:

  • Official Apple repair manuals
  • Original components like screens, batteries, and cameras
  • Specialized toolkits and diagnostics software
  • Post-repair software calibration tools

While this program saves time and money, it’s best for users comfortable handling electronics. If you’re unsure, professional repair services remain a safer choice.

Which Apple devices are eligible for Self Service Repair?

Apple’s Self Service Repair currently supports a select lineup of devices. Here’s a breakdown:

Supported iPhones:

  • iPhone 12, 12 mini, 12 Pro, 12 Pro Max
  • iPhone 13, 13 mini, 13 Pro, 13 Pro Max
  • iPhone 14, 14 Plus, 14 Pro, 14 Pro Max
  • iPhone 15, 15 Plus, 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max
  • iPhone 16, 16 Plus, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max
  • iPhone 16e
  • iPhone SE (3rd generation)
  • iPhone 17, 17 Pro, 17 Pro Max
  • iPhone Air

Supported iPads:

  • iPad Air: M2 and later
  • iPad Pro: M4
  • iPad mini: A17 Pro
  • iPad: A16

Supported Macs:

  • MacBook Air: M1 (2020), M2 (2022), M2 (2023), M3 (2024), M4 (2025)
  • MacBook Pro: M1 (2020), M1 Pro (2021), M2 (2022), M2 Pro (2023), M3 (2023), M3 Pro or M3 Max (2023), M4 (2024), M4 Pro or M4 Max (2024)
  • iMac: M1 (2021), M3 (2023), M4 (2024)
  • Mac mini: M1 (2020), M2 (2023), M2 Pro (2023), M4 (2024)
  • Mac Studio: M1 Max (2022), M2 Ultra or M2 Max (2023), M4 Max (2025)
  • Mac Pro: M2 Ultra (2023)

Other Devices:

  • Studio Display
  • Pro Display XDR
  • Beats Pill (2024)

You can fix common out-of-warranty issues like cracked displays, worn-out batteries, camera problems, and speaker issues. For iPad, you can repair displays, batteries, cameras, and external charging ports. Mac repairs go even deeper—think logic boards, trackpads, and fans.

Where is Apple’s Self Service Repair Program available?

Apple’s DIY repair service is currently available in:

  • United States
  • Europe: Belgium, Denmark, France, Finland, Germany, Italy, Poland, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, UK, and more (33 countries in total)
  • Other regions: Other than in the U.S. and Europe, availability remains limited, but Apple has suggested further rollout.

To access parts and manuals, you must enter your device’s serial number or IMEI. If you’re outside these regions, check Apple’s official Self Service Repair Store for updates.

How to get started with Apple’s Self Service Repair Program

Ready to get your device up and running again? Here is how to start with Apple’s Self Service Repair Program, step by step:

  1. First, determine if your device is eligible for self repair and then find out what you need to fix — perhaps a cracked iPhone 16 screen, damaged iPad charging port, or a worn-out MacBook Air battery. Alternatively, you may run the Diagnostic tool to identify the root cause.
  2. Next, visit Apple’s manuals page and choose the device for which you want to download the repair manual. All the information, such as tools and parts needed, is stated there. Then, choose the kind of repair you want to do.

  3. Then, head to the Self Service Repair Store (you can also buy genuine parts from mobilesentrix). Type in your device’s serial number or IMEI (you can find this in Settings → General → About on iPhones/iPads or About This Mac on Macs).

  4. Choose the repair type to get the original Apple parts you need, such as the new Display or Battery. You can even rent or buy tools—Apple sells kits that include items like torque drivers and repair trays. Rentals are around $49 for a week, but you’ll have to deposit roughly $1,200 (refunded after you return the kit).

Now, just wait for the parts and tools to come. Once you have everything, let’s get to the repair.

  1. Set up a clean, well-lit area to work. Grab a small container for screws (trust me, you don’t want to lose those!) and follow Apple’s safety tips, like grounding yourself to avoid static damage.
  2. With parts and tools in hand, follow the manual step by step. Take your time—some repairs, like swapping an iPhone display, can take an hour or two if you’re new to them. If you hit a snag, Apple’s manuals often include troubleshooting tips.
  3. For some repairs, you’ll need to use Apple’s Repair Assistant and System Configuration to calibrate or verify the fix. This tool guides you through testing your device to ensure it’s working properly.
  4. Next, you can send back the broken component, like an old battery or screen. Apple encourages recycling by offering credit (usually $10–$50, depending on the part). They’ll also provide a prepaid shipping label.
  5. Finally, double-check your repair, clean up your device, and you’re good to go!

Pro tip: Back up your device before starting, just in case something goes wrong. And if you’re feeling unsure, watch a few YouTube tutorials for your specific repair to boost your confidence.

Apple Self Service Repair cost: Is it worth it?

Your repair cost depends on the part, tool rental, and your device model. Here’s a sample cost breakdown:

iPhone 17 Battery Replacement:

  • Battery: $99
  • Tool rental: $49 (or buy tools for $100+)
  • Total (with rental): $148
  • Credit for returning old battery: ~$47
  • Net cost: ~$102

Compare: Apple Store battery replacement is $99 out-of-warranty, so it’s close.

iPhone 16 Display Replacement:

  • Part: $329
  • Tool rental: $49
  • Total (with rental): $378
  • Credit for returning old display: ~$17
  • Net cost: ~$360

Compare: Apple Store display replacement is $279 out-of-warranty, so DIY isn’t cheaper here.

MacBook Air M4 Battery:

  • Part: ~$142
  • Tool rental: $49
  • Total (with rental): ~$191
  • Credit: Varies (~$22)
  • Net cost: ~$169

Compare: Apple Store repair can be $200+, so DIY might save you a bit.

Tool rental is a one-time $49 fee per repair kit, so if you’re fixing multiple things, you can reuse the kit within the week. Buying tools outright is pricier, but it makes sense if you plan to do repairs often. Costs for newer devices like the iPhone 16 or MacBook Pro M4 Max might be higher—check Apple’s Self Service Repair Store for exact prices.

This video showcases Apple’s tools:

Here’s the kicker: if you have AppleCare+, professional repairs are often cheaper ($99 or less per incident), so self-repair might not save you money. Also, shipping fees for parts or returns could add $10–$20, depending on your location. Always compare DIY costs to Apple’s out-of-warranty repair fees (listed on the Apple Support Repair page) before diving in.

Is Self Service repair better than professional repair?

So, should you grab a repair kit and get your hands dirty, or let Apple handle it? It depends on your skills, budget, and goals. Let’s break it down:

Why Self Repair is worth it:

  • You get to fix your device on your schedule—no waiting for an appointment.
  • It’s a chance to master a new skill and understand your device inside out.
  • Returning old parts for recycling feels good and sometimes earns you credit.
  • For complex repairs like Mac logic boards or non-AppleCare+ fixes, DIY can be cheaper than Apple’s out-of-warranty fees.

Why you might choose Apple Repair:

  • Handing your device to a pro is stress-free—no risk of messing up.
  • If you’ve got AppleCare+ coverage, repairs are cheaper compared to DIY.
  • Apple Stores often fix devices in hours; self-repair can take longer, especially if you’re learning.
  • Apple’s self-service repairs include a 90-day guarantee on parts and service; self-repair doesn’t include such a guarantee, but using genuine parts should not void your device’s warranty.

So, if you feel comfortable with electronics — you have replaced a laptop battery or built a personal computer — then self-repair is a solid option. But if you’re nervous about tiny screws or don’t have a steady hand, Apple’s pros are worth it, especially with AppleCare+.

For most folks, the cost difference isn’t huge unless you’re tackling pricier Mac repairs. Check your device’s repair manual and Apple’s pricing first, then decide if you’re up for the challenge.

Repair Your Apple Device at Home!

Apple’s Self Service Repair Program is ideal for users who want to save money and are willing to roll up their sleeves. It gives users the tools and instructions needed to fix common iPhone, iPad, and Mac problems at home using official Apple parts.

Before diving in, compare prices with Apple’s out-of-warranty repair costs. If you’re confident with tools and want full control over the process, give it a shot. Otherwise, professional repair may offer more peace of mind—especially if you’re covered by AppleCare+.

FAQs

Will repairing your iPhone yourself void the warranty?

No. As long as you use genuine Apple parts and follow their official guides, your warranty remains valid. However, if you damage the device during the repair, future repairs may not be covered.

Can anyone use Apple’s Self Service Repair?

Yes, if you’re in a supported country and have a valid serial number or IMEI. Just follow Apple’s guide and safety tips.

You may find these helpful:

  • How to check if your Apple Watch is original or fake
  • How to know when you need to replace your iPhone
  • iPhone repair kits: What they include and how to choose the right one

mainEntity.name: How to search in iMessage?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you want to find something specific in the Messages app, you can perform a search. On the main All Messages screen, swipe down slightly to display the Search box at the top. Pop in your search term and you’ll see results from every conversation related to that term, including text, photos, links, or other items.

mainEntity.name: Do iMessage photos get saved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even with the Automatic Sharing feature enabled, as explained here, photos and videos you receive in Messages are not saved by default. mainEntity.name: Can I delete certain words from the iPhone keyboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: While you can reset your keyboard to remove words from iPhone Predictive text, the iPhone doesn't have a built-in method for deleting certain words from the keyboard. That said, some third-party keyboards allow you to do so.

mainEntity.name: How to change the keyboard on your iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching the keyboard on the iPhone is easy. Open Settings → tap General → Keyboard → Keyboards → tap Add New Keyboard → Edit → drag the preferred keyboard using the three lines. For more details, take a look at this comprehensive guide to changing the keyboard on iPhone.

mainEntity.name: Why does my iPhone say "Cannot Connect to App Store" even with good internet?

acceptedAnswer.text: This may happen due to incorrect date and time settings, issues with your Apple ID, or App Store server problems. Verify these settings first.

mainEntity.name: Will I lose my data if I reset the network or all settings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resetting network settings only erases Wi-Fi and Bluetooth settings. Resetting all settings doesn't erase personal data, but does revert all system settings.

mainEntity.name: Why does the App Store need my location?

mainEntity.name: What if I can't change date/time or location settings?

mainEntity.name: Will repairing your iPhone yourself void the warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. As long as you use genuine Apple parts and follow their official guides, your warranty remains valid. However, if you damage the device during the repair, future repairs may not be covered.

title.rendered: Best Cases for Apple Watch Ultra 3, Ultra 2, and Ultra

content.rendered:
The Apple Watch Ultra series has become a go-to for anyone who wants a tough smartwatch that can handle tough conditions, from gym sessions to outdoor hikes. But even with its built-in durability, adding a case can give you that extra layer of peace of mind.  

In this guide, we’ll break down whether you really need a case for your Apple Watch Ultra and look at the top 6 best cases that balance protection, style, and everyday use.

Table of Contents
  • Do I Need a Case for My Apple Watch Ultra?
  • 6 Best Cases for Apple Watch Ultra Series
    • 1. Spigen Thin Fit Case
    • 2. ESR Case with Armorite Screen Protector
    • 3. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Watch Case and Band
    • 4. amBand M1 Sport Case Band
    • 5. Misxi Thin Protective Case
    • 6. MAGEASY Rugged Metal Case
  • Which Apple Watch Ultra Case Should You Buy?
  • Conclusion

Do I Need a Case for My Apple Watch Ultra? 

The Apple Watch Ultra is Apple’s most rugged smartwatch yet. It comes with a titanium case, a sapphire crystal display, water resistance up to 100 meters, and MIL-STD-810H certification for extreme conditions. So technically, you don’t need a case if you’re mostly using it for casual tracking or office days.  

However, if you love outdoor adventures, gym workouts, or physically demanding activities, a protective case can be a smart investment. Even though titanium is durable, it’s not scratch-proof.

A fall on rough terrain or a scrape against metal gym equipment can still leave marks. A case can help protect your watch from unexpected drops, impacts, and scratches, keeping it looking pristine for longer. 

6 Best Cases for Apple Watch Ultra Series

The Apple Watch Ultra 3 has the same 49mm case diameter and bezel size as the Ultra 2 and the first Ultra, so all three can have the same cases. Six of the best are listed here, each providing a different level of protection, style, and usability.

1. Spigen Thin Fit Case

If you’re looking for a minimalist case, it’s perfect. Its premium polycarbonate shell is lightweight and slim, providing just enough protection against everyday scratches. With a minimal bezel lift, it focuses on bezel protection and maintains full touch sensitivity. 

Moreover, installation is a quick snap, with no band removal required. It’s ideal for urban commuters who want subtle protection without altering the watch’s profile. However, it won’t handle heavy impacts.  

There are two more cases for Apple Watch Ultra.  

  • Spigen Rugged Armor Case for people who need serious protection. 
  • Spigen Lock Fit Case for activities, when a strong lock can prevent accidental pressing of the Action Button.  

2. ESR Case with Armorite Screen Protector 

ESR’s military-grade case stands out for its aluminum alloy build that feels premium without the premium price. It’s designed for full wrap-around coverage that blends right into Ultra’s aesthetic without adding any bulk.  

Moreover, the included ultra-hard tempered glass protectors shield the sapphire display from scratches and impacts up to 110lbs without compromising touch sensitivity. You can easily install the case and screen protectors without detaching the watch straps. 

Overall, it’s a solid all-rounder for anyone who wants robust protection and premium aesthetics. 

3. SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Watch Case and Band

This all-in-one from SUPCASE combines a rugged PC case with a fully adjustable TPU watch band, offering military-standard protection. The double-tongue buckle locks securely around the wrist, and raised bezels lift the screen a millimeter off the surface.  

You’ll also get two tempered glass screens to safeguard the display from scratches. Its precise cutouts keep all the buttons and wireless charging accessible. Overall, it’s a budget win for adventurers. However, the band feels stiffer and looks bulkier.

4. amBand M1 Sport Case Band

The amBand M1 turns your Ultra into an even more stylish and sports-ready device with its stainless-steel connectors and TPU bumper frame. Its brushed metal patch adds grip without snagging sleeves. The included band is breathable and sweat-wicking. 

The included 9H tempered glass screen protector adds an extra layer of protection without affecting touch responsiveness. It’s a great choice for those who want their Apple Watch Ultra to look tough yet modern. 

5. Misxi Thin Protective Case

If you prefer a lightweight and barely-there design, Misxi’s Thin Protective Case might be your match. It has an ultra-thin hard PC shell with built-in tempered glass for protecting the screen and edges. So, the display remains scratch-proof, clear, and touch-sensitive.  

The case molds exactly to the Ultra’s curves, with hollowed crowns and button covers that keep presses snappy. Overall, it’s perfect for people who want to maintain the sleek Apple aesthetic without adding bulk. However, it’s not for high-impact sports, so use it accordingly. 

6. MAGEASY Rugged Metal Case

MAGEASY’s Odyssey case features premium aircraft-grade aluminum with a TPU bumper, similar to the Ultra’s anodized finish. Its 2-in-1 layers absorb shocks, with raised bezels that shield the screen during face-down drops. It keeps scratches at bay while providing your watch with an edgy, fashion-forward look.

It’s a little heavier than plastic or TPU cases, but the build quality and design feel high-end, making it suitable for those who value both protection and style. Band swaps are effortless, as you don’t need to remove the case, and it works with most chargers. 

Which Apple Watch Ultra Case Should You Buy? 

Choosing the right case depends on your lifestyle and how you use your Apple Watch Ultra: 

  • For the ultimate protection: Opt for the SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro or amBand M1 case. They’re built for rugged environments.
  • For protection and style in balance: The ESR case provides robust protection with an elegant design.
  • For light daily protection: Get the Spigen Thin Fit or Misxi Slim Case. They are ideal for everyday use without altering the watch’s appearance.  
  • For premium design lovers: The MAGEASY Metal Case stands out with its elegant, machined-metal appearance.

Conclusion

Ultimately, even though the Apple Watch Ultra is rugged on its own, adding a case can help you preserve its beauty and extend its life, especially if you lead an active lifestyle. Whether you go minimalist or heavy-duty, there’s a perfect case out there for your Ultra.  

Which case do you like the most? Let us know in the comments below!

@graph.name: Spigen Thin Fit Case for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: If you’re looking for a minimalist case, it’s perfect. Its premium polycarbonate shell is lightweight and slim, providing just enough protection against everyday scratches. With a minimal bezel lift, it focuses on bezel protection and maintains full touch sensitivity.

@graph.name: ESR Case with Armorite Screen Protector
@graph.description: ESR’s military-grade case stands out for its aluminum alloy build that feels premium without the premium price. It’s designed for full wrap-around coverage that blends right into Ultra’s aesthetic without adding any bulk.

@graph.name: SUPCASE Unicorn Beetle Pro Watch Case and Band
@graph.description: This all-in-one from SUPCASE combines a rugged PC case with a fully adjustable TPU watch band, offering military-standard protection. The double-tongue buckle locks securely around the wrist, and raised bezels lift the screen a millimeter off the surface.

@graph.name: amBand M1 Sport Case Band for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: The amBand M1 turns your Ultra into an even more stylish and sports-ready device with its stainless-steel connectors and TPU bumper frame. Its brushed metal patch adds grip without snagging sleeves. The included band is breathable and sweat-wicking.

@graph.name: Misxi Thin Protective Case for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: If you prefer a lightweight and barely-there design, Misxi’s Thin Protective Case might be your match. It has an ultra-thin hard PC shell with built-in tempered glass for protecting the screen and edges. So, the display remains scratch-proof, clear, and touch-sensitive.

@graph.name: MAGEASY Rugged Metal Case for Apple Watch Ultra
@graph.description: MAGEASY’s Odyssey case features premium aircraft-grade aluminum with a TPU bumper, similar to the Ultra’s anodized finish. Its 2-in-1 layers absorb shocks, with raised bezels that shield the screen during face-down drops.

title.rendered: Download iOS 26 Wallpapers in 4K: Official & Depth Effect Look

content.rendered:
iOS 26 is a major leap forward, bringing a fresh look with the eye-catching Liquid Glass design and official wallpapers. They are stunning with smooth gradients, gentle reflections, and see-through layers. However, if you want to make your screen stand out, try the Depth Effect wallpaper, which makes your screen feel alive and immersive.  

Here, we have curated the official, stunning Depth Effect iPhone wallpapers that showcase the beauty of iOS 26. Let’s explore!

Table of Contents
  • Download Official iOS 26 Wallpapers in 4K (Light & Dark Versions)
    • 1. Dusk
    • 2. Halo
    • 3. Shadow
    • 4. Sky
  • 10 Best iOS 26 Depth Effect iPhone Wallpapers in 4K
    • 1. Beach Panorama
    • 2. Beautiful Seaside Landscape
    • 3. Reflections Inside the Cave
    • 4. Macro Shot of Canyon Walls
    • 5. Scenic Mountain View
    • 6. Crystal Beach Ball
    • 7. Misty Sea Against Sky
    • 8. Beautiful Cave with Flowing Sand
    • 9. Colorful Textural Canyon
    • 10. Sunset on Mountains
  • How to Set a Wallpaper on Your iPhone

Download Official iOS 26 Wallpapers in 4K (Light & Dark Versions)

Apple’s iOS 26 wallpaper gives you four stylish options in Light or Dark mode for both your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Each one is designed to look great and keep things clear, so you can personalize your device just the way you like it.

1. Dusk

This design features hues of lavender and plum, gently transitioning into blush pink and creams.

Download Light | Download Dark

2. Halo

The Halo wallpaper captures the beautiful pastel tones of aqua blue, purple, and pink colors

Download Light | Download Dark

3. Shadow

It offers cool blue tones in the Light version and deep purple hues for the Dark one.

Download Light | Download Dark

4. Sky

Sky is all about different shades of blue layered beautifully to create a calm aesthetic.

Download Light | Download Dark

Once downloaded, you can set it as your Home screen or Lock screen from the Photos app. Here’s how to do it.

10 Best iOS 26 Depth Effect iPhone Wallpapers in 4K

Now, let’s have some variations and a bit of natural landscapes. Each wallpaper is in 4K resolution and is free to download to your device. If you love customizing your screen, you might also want to check out our stunning Depth Effect wallpapers for iPhone for a more dynamic look. Go through the collection, then tap the Download button below.

1. Beach Panorama

This wallpaper shows a dreamy beach wrapped in rugged mountains and turquoise waves. It’s wild and beautifully remote, like a secret escape on a long summer drive.

Download

2. Beautiful Seaside Landscape

A quiet wave glows under the moonlight, curling through the deep blue sea like liquid gold. This ocean wallpaper feels calm and a little bit magical, ideal if you like dark aesthetics.

Download

3. Reflections Inside the Cave

If you prefer a more mysterious iPhone aesthetic, you will love this wallpaper. It is a lovely reflection of the canyon walls, like a secret painting of nature.

Download

4. Macro Shot of Canyon Walls

Soft light brushes over the textured curves of red canyon walls, creating a moody play of shadows. This wallpaper is like standing inside Earth’s own masterpiece, carved by time.

Download

5. Scenic Mountain View

Golden canyons meet a mirror-still pool, reflecting layers of red rock under a deep blue sky. I like this wallpaper for its calming, timeless vibe.

Download

6. Crystal Beach Ball

A sunset captured inside a crystal ball. It’s dreamy, cinematic, and a little surreal, perfect for those who love seeing beauty from a different angle.

Download

7. Misty Sea Against Sky

Another ocean wallpaper with a bit of stormy clouds. Its soft waves complement the Liquid Glass aesthetics.

Download

8. Beautiful Cave with Flowing Sand

A gentle stream of sand flows through the heart of a glowing blue canyon. Download it and enjoy a moment frozen in nature’s hourglass.

Download

9. Colorful Textural Canyon

Another wallpaper with a beautiful dark aesthetic. A golden light peeks through waves of red sandstone, depicting mystery, depth, and natural artistry carved by time itself.

Download

10. Sunset on Mountains

A lone traveler walks beneath a fading sunset, surrounded by quiet mountains. This wallpaper captures the peace of solitude and serves as a reminder of how small we are amid nature’s vast beauty.

Download

Follow these quick steps to easily set any wallpaper on your iPhone’s Home or Lock Screen.

What is the ‘Liquid Glass’ design in iOS 26?

Apple’s new Liquid Glass design in iOS 26 brings a refreshing, modern vibe to your device. With see-through layers, soft shapes, and gentle lighting, your screen feels deeper and more relaxing. It’s all about making your iPhone look clear, lively, and welcoming, just the way Apple likes to do things.

How many new wallpapers does iOS 26 include?

With iOS 26, Apple brings a fresh signature wallpaper that feels uniquely yours. You’ll get four versions to match your mood and setup: Light and Dark options for your Home Screen, plus slightly different Light and Dark styles for your Lock Screen. Each one is carefully designed to look great and keep everything easy to read.

Which devices support the iOS 26 wallpaper?

Love the look of iOS 26? While it’s made for iPhone 11 and newer, you can still enjoy this stylish wallpaper on any device you have, older iPhones, iPads, Macs, Android phones, or even your computer. Just download the image and resize it to fit your screen perfectly.

Enjoy the gorgeous official iOS 26 wallpaper in crisp 4K (1290 x 2796 pixels). It looks sharp and vibrant on any device, making your screen stand out.

Can I use these wallpapers on non-Apple devices?

Absolutely! These wallpapers look great on Android phones, tablets, PCs, and Macs. You might need to crop or resize them for the best fit, but the designs will still stand out on any device.

Why does Apple release just one signature wallpaper each year?

Every year, Apple’s new wallpaper isn’t just about a fresh look; it’s a way to show off what makes the latest iOS special. Each one is designed to capture the update’s vibe, giving your device a unique feel that’s easy to spot. These wallpapers have become memorable symbols for each iOS version over the years.
